title: Machine Learning in Network Intrusion Detection: A Cross-Dataset Generalization Study
reported_result_or_value: Reports 9/16 within-dataset experiments with MCC above 99.6%, while average MCC falls from 94.63% within-dataset to 29.35% in cross-dataset testing across CIC/LycoS datasets.
data_separation_basis: The within-dataset and source-only cross-dataset partitions are described.
leakage_control_basis: Training-subset grid search is reported, but all preprocessing-fit details are not itemized.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Source and target datasets are explicit and target data are not used for source-only training.
selection_independence_basis: Hyperparameters use a training subset, but the single-attack analysis reports the highest result from three runs.
statistical_reporting_basis: Three runs are performed for single-attack experiments, but the highest result is reported rather than a full variability summary.
reproducibility_basis: The new dataset and experimental environment are documented, while complete training-code availability is not clear.
overall_quality_basis: The source-only protocol and data partitions are clear, with no identified major leakage or test-informed model selection.
deployment_limitation: Shows dataset dependence but does not test unknown-attack rejection or reliability under the same protocol.

title: Cross-Dataset Transformer-IDS with Calibration and AUC Optimization (Evaluated on NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017)
reported_result_or_value: Reports Transformer-IDS cross-dataset gains, with AUC improved by about 10-20% and F1-score by 10+ points over baselines, plus probability-calibration and ECE analysis.
data_separation_basis: Cross-dataset experiments are described, but the calibration-data split is inconsistent.
leakage_control_basis: No definite feature leakage is established, but inconsistent calibration-data provenance prevents a clear rating.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Source-target tasks are explicit, while the calibration-data source under target testing is inconsistent.
selection_independence_basis: The independence of calibration fitting from reported target-test data is not established consistently.
statistical_reporting_basis: Three-seed variability and calibration metrics are reported, but inference is limited.
reproducibility_basis: Method details are available, but complete reproducibility resources are not reported clearly.
overall_quality_basis: Three-seed variability and calibration metrics are present, but calibration-data provenance is inconsistent.
deployment_limitation: Provides pairwise cross-dataset and reliability evidence but does not test unknown-attack rejection in the same experiment.

title: Cross-Dataset Temporal and Semantic Generalization of Intrusion Detection Models for the Future Internet
reported_result_or_value: Macro-F1 drops from 0.84-0.96 in-domain to 0.69-0.78 under future-Internet cross-dataset testing, with benign FPR about 0.30.
data_separation_basis: Source-only training and held-out cross-domain evaluation are described.
leakage_control_basis: Normalisation is fitted using training data, and no major leakage was identified.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Source and target domains are explicit, with no target retraining, adaptation, or threshold tuning.
selection_independence_basis: Hyperparameters and thresholds are fixed before target evaluation.
statistical_reporting_basis: Five independent runs and Wilcoxon tests are reported, but exact p-values, sidedness, and multiple-comparison correction are absent.
reproducibility_basis: Datasets and protocol details are reported, while complete executable resources are not clearly available.
overall_quality_basis: Source-only evaluation and fixed selection are clear; statistical reporting has bounded omissions.
deployment_limitation: Shows domain-shift risk but does not combine shift with unseen-attack rejection and calibration.

title: TriHID: Towards verifiable domain adaptation-based IoT intrusion detection in heterogeneous environment
reported_result_or_value: Evaluates multi-source, semi-supervised, unsupervised, and open-set domain-adaptation settings for IoT IDS.
data_separation_basis: Multiple evaluation regimes and sub-datasets are described, but repeated split execution is not clear.
leakage_control_basis: No specific leakage is established, although the reporting does not support a fully clear leakage audit.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Target supervision regimes and heterogeneous feature, distribution, and attack settings are explicitly distinguished.
selection_independence_basis: Independent model and hyperparameter selection for every benchmarked method is not reported clearly.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run uncertainty and conventional variability reporting are not clear.
reproducibility_basis: The dataset construction and benchmark methods are documented, but reproducibility resources are not reported clearly.
overall_quality_basis: Target-access regimes are clear, while repeated-run and reproducibility support are limited.
deployment_limitation: Useful benchmark evidence, but reliability and abstention are not included as a third deployment requirement.

title: Few-shot network intrusion detection method based on multi-domain fusion and cross-attention
reported_result_or_value: Reports 99.03% accuracy at K=10 on CIC-IDS2017, 98.64% on CICIDS2018, and more than 95.13% cross-domain accuracy.
data_separation_basis: Training, support, and query roles are explicitly described.
leakage_control_basis: No major leakage was identified, although preprocessing-fit details are not fully itemized in the manuscript extraction.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Target support access is explicit and source-only cross-domain testing is reported separately.
selection_independence_basis: The episodic support/query protocol separates model development from query evaluation.
statistical_reporting_basis: Results are averaged over ten trials.
reproducibility_basis: The article and experimental details are accessible, while a complete executable package is not the basis of the rating.
overall_quality_basis: Target support is explicit, ten-trial averaging is reported, and source-only testing is separated.
deployment_limitation: The few-shot support/query setting is not a full source-only deployment test with unknown attacks and reliability checks.

title: Multi-source refined adversarial domain adaptation with transfer complementarity infusion for IoT intrusion detection under limited samples
reported_result_or_value: Reports more than 95% average detection accuracy across four IoT datasets under limited-sample tasks.
data_separation_basis: Limited-sample experimental scenarios are disclosed, but full split independence is not reported in sufficient detail.
leakage_control_basis: No definite leakage is identified, but preprocessing and split controls are not fully auditable.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The use of limited labelled target samples and the adaptation scenarios are explicit.
selection_independence_basis: Independent selection of all settings from held-out target tests is not established.
statistical_reporting_basis: Conventional repeated-run or uncertainty reporting is limited.
reproducibility_basis: The method and scenarios are described, but reproducibility resources remain limited.
overall_quality_basis: Target access is disclosed and results are interpretable despite limited variability and reproducibility support.
deployment_limitation: Addresses domain adaptation but does not jointly evaluate unknown attacks and reliability.

title: Wasserstein distance guided feature Tokenizer transformer domain adaptation for network intrusion detection
reported_result_or_value: On UQ->CIC, reports ACC 0.9234, F1 0.9186, recall 0.8639, and AUC 0.9468; average F1 across 20 transfer tasks is 0.7791.
data_separation_basis: Source-target tasks are defined, but the use of all data during scaling weakens split separation.
leakage_control_basis: Scaling is described as using all data, creating a material leakage concern.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Unlabelled target data and pseudo-labels are explicitly used for adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: Important settings are selected using performance on the reported target tasks.
statistical_reporting_basis: Twenty transfer tasks are reported, but repeated-run uncertainty is not clear.
reproducibility_basis: Method details are available, while complete code and rerun support are not clearly reported.
overall_quality_basis: All-data scaling and target-task-informed setting selection materially weaken confidence.
deployment_limitation: Improves shifted known-class detection but does not test withheld unknown attacks or calibrated abstention.

title: A Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection Method Based on Nonlinear Augmented Explicit Features
reported_result_or_value: Reports more than 85% accuracy in the difficult UNSW-NB15->CICIDS2017 cross-domain setting.
data_separation_basis: Target samples used for adaptation are not clearly separated from target evaluation samples.
leakage_control_basis: The unresolved adaptation-evaluation overlap creates a material leakage risk.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Labelled-source and unlabelled-target access are stated, but the target partition roles are unclear.
selection_independence_basis: Settings appear to be selected from reported target results.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run variability and inferential support are not reported clearly.
reproducibility_basis: The architecture and experiments are described, but complete reproducibility resources are not clear.
overall_quality_basis: Target adaptation and evaluation are insufficiently separated and settings appear target-result informed.
deployment_limitation: Targets domain mismatch but does not integrate open-set rejection and reliability.

title: A novel open set Energy-based Flow Classifier for Network Intrusion Detection
reported_result_or_value: Reports AUROC 0.859 and AUPRC 0.993 on a reproduced CICIDS2017 open-set benchmark, with macro-F1 0.752 in closed-set testing.
data_separation_basis: Cross-validation and leave-one-class-out evaluation are explicitly described.
leakage_control_basis: Preprocessing and evaluation scripts are reported, with no identified leakage concern.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The principal evidence is an open-set benchmark rather than a source-target domain-adaptation test.
selection_independence_basis: The open-set threshold is derived from training data.
statistical_reporting_basis: Cross-validation and confidence intervals are reported.
reproducibility_basis: The authors provide preprocessing and experimental scripts and a project repository.
overall_quality_basis: Cross-validation, leave-one-class-out testing, training-derived thresholding, and reproducibility resources are reported.
deployment_limitation: Useful open-set evidence but not a full deep-learning joint deployment test with cross-dataset reliability.

title: Unknown intrusion traffic detection method based on unsupervised learning and open-set recognition
reported_result_or_value: Reports more than 88.5% accuracy for misuse detection and more than 88.2% for anomaly detection on CICIDS2017 open-set testing.
data_separation_basis: The open-set construction is described, while an independent validation role is unclear.
leakage_control_basis: No specific leakage is established, but preprocessing and validation controls are incompletely reported.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The reported experiment is primarily a single-dataset open-set evaluation.
selection_independence_basis: OpenMax and related operating-parameter selection are not tied clearly to independent validation data.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated runs and variability reporting are insufficiently clear.
reproducibility_basis: Code availability and complete rerun support are insufficiently clear.
overall_quality_basis: The open-set design is interpretable, but validation, parameter selection, variability, and code reporting are limited.
deployment_limitation: Tests unknown-class handling but not rejection stability under target-dataset shift.

title: Open Set Dandelion Network for IoT Intrusion Detection
reported_result_or_value: Reports OSDN open-set domain-adaptation results across source-target intrusion tasks, with ACC 53.78-76.18 and IND-mode accuracy 62.31-90.11 across openness settings up to 0.71.
data_separation_basis: Source-target tasks are described, but split-selection detail is limited.
leakage_control_basis: No definite leakage is established, although target adaptation and split controls are not fully auditable.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Unlabelled-target adaptation and openness settings are explicit.
selection_independence_basis: Independent model and operating-setting selection is not reported clearly.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run basis and variability reporting are limited.
reproducibility_basis: The method and tasks are described, but complete reproducibility resources are not clear.
overall_quality_basis: Target adaptation is explicit, but split selection and variability reporting remain limited.
deployment_limitation: Provides pairwise cross-dataset and open-set evidence without calibration, uncertainty, or abstention.

title: Toward Open-World Network Intrusion Detection via Open Recognition and Inspection
reported_result_or_value: Improves open-recognition accuracy over CADE by 1.08-1.92% on USTC-TFC2016, 0.91-3.21% on CIC-IDS2018, and 10.50% on TON-IoT.
data_separation_basis: Known and unknown partitions are explicitly defined.
leakage_control_basis: No major leakage is identified, but the complete preprocessing-fit audit is not reported in the extraction.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The reported evidence uses within-dataset open-world partitions rather than source-target adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: Key operating parameters are selected experimentally without an independent validation protocol.
statistical_reporting_basis: Comparative results are reported, while repeated-run uncertainty is not sufficiently clear.
reproducibility_basis: Method details are reported, but complete code and rerun resources are not clear.
overall_quality_basis: Known and unknown partitions are clear, but operating-parameter selection is not independently validated.
deployment_limitation: Adds unknown-sample inspection but not cross-dataset reliability testing.

title: nNFST: A single-model approach for multiclass novelty detection in network intrusion detection systems
reported_result_or_value: Reports 97.12-99.56% accuracy for multiclass classification, 94.53-99.33% for novel-attack detection, and MCC 0.825-0.975 for multiclass novelty detection.
data_separation_basis: Leave-one-attack-out evaluation is explicitly described.
leakage_control_basis: Preprocessing fitting is not tied clearly to training data only.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The principal evidence is within-dataset novelty testing rather than source-target adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: The anomaly threshold is not tied clearly to training or validation data.
statistical_reporting_basis: Multiple novelty partitions are evaluated, but conventional repeated-run uncertainty is not clear.
reproducibility_basis: The method is described, while complete executable resources are not clearly reported.
overall_quality_basis: Leave-one-attack-out testing is clear, but preprocessing and threshold independence are uncertain.
deployment_limitation: The result depends on selected novelty partitions and lacks cross-dataset calibration.

title: Adaptive Semi-Supervised Algorithm for Intrusion Detection and Unknown Attack Identification
reported_result_or_value: Reports CIC-IDS2017 F1 95.2% and FOR 10.7%, and Kitsune F1 83.2% and FOR 15.8%, under normal-only training; for real-vehicle data, the abstract reports FOR 13% while the body reports FPR 0.130.
data_separation_basis: Attack-containing validation data serve as the principal evaluation set, weakening independent evaluation.
leakage_control_basis: No direct preprocessing leakage is established, but the validation-evaluation role is confounded.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The main experiments are normal-only anomaly evaluations rather than source-target adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: The anomaly threshold and its selection data are not reported.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run uncertainty is absent and the vehicle metric description is inconsistent.
reproducibility_basis: The article is accessible, but threshold details and internally consistent reporting are incomplete.
overall_quality_basis: Unreported thresholding and confounded validation substantially weaken the result.
deployment_limitation: Useful normal-only anomaly evidence, but it is closer to binary anomaly detection than full multiclass open-set deployment testing.

title: Enhancing trustworthiness in ML-based network intrusion detection with uncertainty quantification
reported_result_or_value: Evaluates uncertainty-aware OoD/open-set detection on ToN-IoT and CICIDS2017; detailed ToN-IoT 6U reports AUROC20* 0.72 and AUROC 0.92, while CICIDS results are averaged across scenarios.
data_separation_basis: Training, validation, and testing roles are explicitly separated.
leakage_control_basis: No material leakage or test-set reuse was identified in the assessed protocol.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The principal evidence concerns OoD and unknown-class stress rather than source-target adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: Threshold selection is separated from held-out testing.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated runs and uncertainty estimates are reported.
reproducibility_basis: The experimental method is well reported, while complete public executable resources are not the sole basis of the rating.
overall_quality_basis: Data separation, threshold selection, repetitions, and uncertainty estimates are clearly reported.
deployment_limitation: Links uncertainty with unknown samples but not under a full cross-dataset source-target shift.

title: Towards trustworthy cybersecurity operations using Bayesian Deep Learning to improve uncertainty quantification of anomaly detection
reported_result_or_value: Reports AUC-rejection 0.986±0.001 on UNSW-NB15 and 0.846±0.011 on CIC-IDS2017 using Bayesian autoencoder uncertainty.
data_separation_basis: Train and test use are described, while an independent selection set is not fully clear.
leakage_control_basis: No definite leakage is established, but the selection protocol prevents a fully clear rating.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The two datasets are evaluated independently rather than through source-target adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: Model or distribution selection appears to use the best observed reported result.
statistical_reporting_basis: Seven-seed results and variability are reported.
reproducibility_basis: Code is not released.
overall_quality_basis: Seven-seed reporting supports interpretation, but observed-result model selection and absent code limit confidence.
deployment_limitation: Evaluates uncertainty rejection without combining unknown attack families and cross-dataset shift.

title: Trustable Network Intrusion Detection System through Wisdomnet and Uncertainty Measures
reported_result_or_value: Reports base F1 values of 0.998, 0.994, 0.985, and 0.988; WisdomNet reaches near-zero or zero accepted-sample error in several settings at roughly 5-7% rejection, while some uncertainty-threshold settings require higher rejection.
data_separation_basis: Validation-based thresholding and separate testing are reported.
leakage_control_basis: No major leakage is identified, although complete preprocessing controls are not documented in the extraction.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The assessment is a within-dataset selective-prediction evaluation.
selection_independence_basis: Rejection and uncertainty thresholds are selected using validation data.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated runs and statistical uncertainty are absent.
reproducibility_basis: Code is not released.
overall_quality_basis: Validation-based thresholding and separate testing are clear, but statistical and code support are absent.
deployment_limitation: Rejection reduces accepted-sample error, but outcomes depend on threshold and coverage choices.

title: Calibrated Uncertainty Estimation for Trustworthy Deep IoT Attack Detection
reported_result_or_value: Reports 98.4% accuracy, about 4.86% false alarms on IoT-23, selected calibration temperature T=1.39, and 96.42% retention at the top-F1 operating point.
data_separation_basis: A separate validation set is used for calibration.
leakage_control_basis: No material preprocessing or test-set leakage was identified for calibration fitting.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The reported shift is within the IoT-23 design rather than source-target dataset adaptation.
selection_independence_basis: Calibration fitting is independent, but selective thresholds and OoD subsets appear chosen from reported performance.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run uncertainty is not reported.
reproducibility_basis: The method and calibration procedure are described, while complete rerun resources are not clear.
overall_quality_basis: Independent calibration supports interpretation, but selective operating choices and absent repeated-run uncertainty limit confidence.
deployment_limitation: Does not provide a full source-target protocol with withheld attack families.

title: Intrusion detection in Software-Defined Networking using hybrid Bayesian model averaging for reliable uncertainty quantification
reported_result_or_value: Reports 99.93% accuracy and F1 on InSDN, and 99.89% accuracy with 99.90% F1 on CIC-DDoS2019 using CNN-LSTM with MC Dropout and Bayesian model averaging.
data_separation_basis: Validation for model selection is unclear.
leakage_control_basis: Normalisation is described before splitting, creating a material leakage concern.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: The datasets are evaluated in separate within-dataset experiments, not a source-target protocol.
selection_independence_basis: Independent model selection and operating-setting selection are not established.
statistical_reporting_basis: Repeated-run uncertainty for the headline performance is not reported clearly.
reproducibility_basis: The architecture is described, but the protocol omissions prevent complete reproduction.
overall_quality_basis: Pre-split normalisation and unclear model selection materially weaken the reported evidence.
deployment_limitation: Quantifies uncertainty but does not jointly test cross-dataset generalization and unknown-attack rejection.

title: Dataset-centric evaluation of federated intrusion detection models in IoT networks
reported_result_or_value: Reports federated in-domain macro-F1 up to 98%, cross-dataset drops of up to 30 percentage points, and 15-25% communication reduction with FedNova.
data_separation_basis: Federated and cross-dataset scenarios are described, but all split details are not fully auditable.
leakage_control_basis: No major leakage is established, although inconsistent reporting prevents a completely clear protocol rating.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Feature and label harmonisation and dataset roles are explicit.
selection_independence_basis: The selection protocol is interpretable, but some implementation counts are inconsistent.

overall_quality_basis: Explicit harmonisation supports interpretation, while inconsistent counts and absent repeated-run uncertainty limit confidence.
deployment_limitation: Shows federated deployment realism without combining unknown-attack rejection and calibrated abstention.

title: FORT-IDS: a federated, optimized, robust and trustworthy intrusion detection system for IIoT security
reported_result_or_value: Reports asymmetric cross-dataset transfer, with F1=0.39 for DDoS->UNSW and F1=0.99 for UNSW->DDoS; replacing CNN-LSTM with a pruned CNN reduces median latency from 120 ms to 25 ms while accuracy changes from 98% to 92%.
data_separation_basis: Leakage controls and repeated evaluation structure are described.
leakage_control_basis: No major leakage was identified in the assessed protocol.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Source-target directions are explicit, but dataset counts and the role of target fine-tuning are inconsistent.

overall_quality_basis: Leakage control and multi-seed support are strong, but target-fine-tuning and dataset-count inconsistencies remain.
deployment_limitation: Provides deployment measurement without closing the joint cross-dataset, open-set, and reliability gap.

title: Class Incremental Learning for Network-Agnostic Intrusion Detection Systems
reported_result_or_value: Reports cross-network class-incremental adaptation: in the multiclass setting, iCaRL+ gives about 5% DropOld and 4% DropAll; in the binary misuse-detection setting, it reports about 99% F1 and 100% AUC.
data_separation_basis: The train-test partition is not reported clearly.
leakage_control_basis: Insufficient partition detail prevents a clear leakage assessment.
target_access_and_harmonization_basis: Target-network benign data used for adaptation are disclosed.
selection_independence_basis: Independent model and operating-setting selection is not reported clearly.
statistical_reporting_basis: Variability and repeated-run reporting are absent or unclear.

deployment_limitation: Useful adaptation evidence but not a complete unknown-attack and calibrated-abstention protocol.

title: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning for Network Intrusion Detection Systems
reported_result_or_value: Reports up to 95% F1 on C_all, up to +5% over the non-FSCIL baseline, and about 95% F1 with a 10 s traffic-observation cutoff.

title: Federated transfer learning for rare attack class detection in network intrusion detection systems
reported_result_or_value: Reports 98.90% accuracy and 95.79% F1 on CSE-CIC-IDS2018, 98.70% and 95.41% on UNSW-NB15, and 97.92% and 94.56% on Edge-IIoT.
data_separation_basis: Split construction is not reported clearly enough for independent verification.

title: TICPS: A trustworthy collaborative intrusion detection framework for industrial cyber-physical systems
reported_result_or_value: Reports robustness under three poisoning attacks, with about 93-94% intrusion-detection accuracy when up to 80% of industrial agents are malicious.

reported_result_or_value: Reports merged-scenario accuracies of 99.73% on MQTT-bi, 99.77% on MQTT-uni, 99.79% on CICIDS2017, and 98.31% on ToN-IoT.

title: FedMSE: Semi-supervised federated learning approach for IoT network intrusion detection
reported_result_or_value: Reports FedMSE AUC/accuracy performance of 97.30±0.49 versus 93.98±2.90 in the high non-IID setting, with the same values under 50% gateway participation.

title: Trustworthy Adaptive AI for Real-Time Intrusion Detection in Industrial IoT Security
reported_result_or_value: Reports 96.4% accuracy, 2.1% FPR, and about 35 ms latency on Raspberry Pi 5 in IIoT deployment.
